name: label_errors
note: Error bodies are FastAPI's {"detail": str}. 422 when the store refuses a label or a patch, 404 for an unknown or deleted id. A stamp off the bar grid is refused, never snapped -- it means the timestamp did not come from a loaded bar.

body.detail: 1704207660000 is not the end of a 5m bucket (rth=True); label stamps must be a bar's t_ms as served by /bars
cannot patch ['source']: only ['label_type', 'payload'] are mutable. A label's bars are its identity (delete and re-create); its source changes by review.
